sim.quick_start.description: One call that builds a working scene, needing no IDs: a ground plane, physics scene, lights and a camera aimed at it, in the current stage if it is new and empty, otherwise a new one. With robot, called again on a scene it built, it adds the robot and keeps your objects. No real-robot wiring. Edits go to the session layer; sim__stage__save keeps them. The timeline stays stopped unless play=true. Refuses to drop unsaved edits unless discard_changes=true. Returns IDs, paths and next steps; on Newton a newton field (rate, buffers). For the UR5e work cell, use workcell__cell..

sim.timeline.description: Play, pause, stop, initialize or reset. initialize briefly plays a stopped timeline then pauses it, so physics may advance; it refuses a playing timeline. Play reports physics_ready. Reset is the call after a failed run: it cancels this pack's jobs and stops the timeline; safe to repeat. sim__simulation__step advances exact steps. Stop rewinds physics and awaits pending render/writer completion. TIMELINE_BUSY or TIMELINE_INTERRUPTED requires inspection before retry. The session edit target is leased until Stop. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

sim.stage.save.description: Export a flattened copy of the stage to a new file. Includes session edits, to a new basename (.usda added if absent) in the output root or in `directory` under your home; with format=urdf one robot as URDF plus meshes. Never overwrites or switches the current stage. External texture paths remain dependencies; process-bound render pipelines are omitted, and unknown native pipeline content refuses. sim.simulation.run.description: Run your own controller in the physics loop as a job. sim.arm.ik.description: Inverse kinematics for a link target. For any robot with revolute or prismatic joints, read from its own USD joints (no per-robot file): the joint values that put a link at a target position and optional orientation, nearest the current pose. Solves only unless move=true; no collision check or path. Needs a playing or paused timeline. Refuses if its model disagrees with physics. Mimic joints are treated as independent. Returns joint_targets for sim__joints__move and the errors; reached=false means out of reach or limits. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

offset.description: Optional [x, y, z] in the link's frame, stage units: place this point (a fingertip) instead of the link's origin.

sim.joints.command.description: Command joint position or velocity targets. On an initialized articulation, by name (targets) or in DOF order (positions), and/or velocity targets, on the selected PhysX or qualified Newton backend. Radians for revolute, stage units for prismatic. Out-of-limit values are refused unless clamp=true, which reports what it clamped; unknown names list the valid ones. sim.joints.move.description: Step a paused simulation until joints settle. Steps a PAUSED, initialized simulation until named joint targets are within tolerance or max_steps is used, then reports settled and each joint's error. From stopped, sim__timeline action=initialize briefly plays then pauses. A joint held by contact or a weak drive reports settled=false: clear the path, raise gains with sim__joints__gains, or retry with more steps. Runtime only; never pumps the app loop. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

sim.physics.apply.description: Add or remove colliders and rigid bodies, set mass. Add or remove a collider, rigid body and kinematic state, or set mass / density, on any prim; session layer only, and undo with sim__prim__revert. collider can set an approximation (convexHull, convexDecomposition, boundingSphere, boundingCube, meshSimplification, none).
